before.name: James “Doc” Holiday
before.description: James “Doc” Holiday is a longtime Black liberation and prison organizer associated with the Black Guerrilla Family and the development of Black August commemorations. His political work arose inside prison, rather than from the offense that produced his current sentence. A federal jury convicted Holiday in June 1988 of two counts of possessing cocaine with intent to distribute as part of the Elrader Browning prosecution, and Judge Stephen Wilson sentenced him to life without parole on August 29, 1988. Holiday later spent years in federal supermax custody and continued writing and organizing around Black liberation and prison conditions. A 2023 prisoner-support appeal listed the then-80-year-old Holiday at USP McCreary under federal register number 86555-012.
